rules: Only an existing canonical Community row created by the exact Owner may authorize progression.
Detached/null author or creator rows do not authorize progression.
The verifier is read-only and selects only row identity needed to prove ownership.
No Community content body, media, sensor overlay or location is copied into World progression.
Repository/database failures propagate so the World ledger can fail closed as source-authority unavailable.
This verifier is not automatically wired into a public route by this slice.
